222-527-997-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

5267-5315-7924.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

4881-5929-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5929-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

728-1202-3249-3755.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-3249-3755.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2150-3899-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1833-2034-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1624-5864-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2862-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl
1618-2440-2862-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2862-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1651-2097-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4708-7296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-2569-7193.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Omni-Changeling.
Activate Omni-Changeling by tapping it.
When Omni-Changeling becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

141-3495-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3495-5256.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3495-5256.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-851-1270-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1270-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1818-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1818-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

413-4484-4871-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
413-4484-4871-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
413-4484-4871-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-4484-4871-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

215-4010-4785-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-4785-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

222-527-4785-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4785-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

49-1799-4050-5359.description:
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

710-4775-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha, adding {R}.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

92-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
92-6191.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Gain life.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent that lost life.
Resolve a Bloodthirsty Conqueror trigger, gaining 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3504-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mercurial Pretender has a power of at least 2.
1912-3504-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mercurial Pretender and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mercurial Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mercurial Pretender to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-2897.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Gigantoplasm.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Gigantoplasm and another permanent you control.
Activate Gigantoplasm by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

225-1021-1315-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five devotion to any color.
225-1021-1315-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Nykthos.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
If you have at least six devotion to any color, this combo nets infinite mana.

1912-4050-4893-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1912-4050-4893-5140.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Training Grounds and Biomancer's Familiar, putting the creature card onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

195-3371-4893.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
195-3371-4893.description:
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting Codie.
Holding priority, activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve Chain Stasis, untapping Codie and causing you to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, with the copy targeting Codie.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may choose not to copy Chain Stasis and cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Scholar on the battlefield as Jetfire, Air Guardian.
Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-3490-4659.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

2043-3499-4295.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Powerstone Shard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate the Powerstone Shard token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Powerstone Shard you control.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate the original Powerstone Shard by tapping it, adding {C} for each Powerstone Shard you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3.
